name: Your Dearest Boyfriend
source:
"Your Dearest Boyfriend" is a psychological dating sim for adults, an erotic thriller digital visual novel, inspired by the universe of the game Your Boyfriend. You'll meet Victor — charming, intelligent, and dangerously obsessed with you. Along the way, you'll encounter other love interests and uncover secrets that blur the line between love and obsession. 

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/cw/YourDearestBoyfriend]Patreon[/url] and [url=https://yourdearestboyfriend.straw.page/]Strawpage[/url]]
